ruling.explanation:
Trip TRP-02837, route-deviation dispute filed by the rider, contested amount $4.50.

Rider, the measured facts are not in dispute. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02837) is clean for policy purposes: 104 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) are not met and the trace is not impaired. It records a trace_distance_km of 13.2. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02837) is METERED with charged_total 19.32 and the booked optimal_distance_km was 10.0.

The decisive point is the drop-off change, which turns the baseline. Your own chat message (EV-CHAT-02837, sent 17:03:32) says you changed the pin, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-02837) shows dropoff_amended_at 17:04:12 with a stored amended_optimal_distance_km of 13.4 and amended_optimal_duration_min of 18.5. POL-RD-05 therefore requires the POL-RD-01 test to be re-run between the amended endpoints, and the baseline becomes the platform's stored re-quote of 13.4 km — I take it as recorded and do not derive a substitute. Against that baseline there is no excess: 13.2 - 13.4 = -0.2 km, which cannot clear POL-RD-01 (excess must exceed 20% of optimal AND 0.8 km absolute). No deviation survives the recomputation and POL-RD-05 directs the outcome to NO_ACTION.

The rider's advocate's booked-baseline figure (excess 3.2 km / 32.0%) is not the operative measure: POL-RD-01 requires establishment and materiality to be judged on the excess REMAINING after any POL-RD-05 adjustment, and the POL-RD-05 adjustment removes it. That claim is answered and outweighed by the amended baseline.

Consequences: POL-RD-02 does not run, so no distance-or-time refund issues (had it run on the booked baseline the arithmetic would be charged_total 19.32 - recomputed_fare 16.02 = 3.30; neither that nor the 4.50 contested amount is payable, because no deviation is established). POL-RD-04 is unavailable and I say so: the instruction meets POL-RD-04(a) and (b), but chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run on this record and the clause is unavailable; it is not needed, because POL-RD-05 resolves the case. POL-RD-09: no ERP gantry and no airport surcharge line was charged, so there is no billing-integrity correction and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. POL-RD-06: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d 237 (ratio 0.004), so no repeat-deviation pattern, no full-refund uplift and no driver-conduct referral. POL-RD-08: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, so no corroboration uplift applies. POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not fire either: the billed distance (13.2 km) is not less than the trace (13.2 km), so there is no unbilled-kilometre shortfall and no driver compensation.

The driver's account ('the rider moved the drop-off pin during the trip') is consistent with the chat log and the amendment timestamp; it is not a traffic-cause defence, no party invoked POL-RD-03, and the MISSING advisory (EV-ADVIS-02837-01, weight 0.0) therefore has no bearing on this case. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: confidence is well above 0.70, all trip identifiers and timestamps agree, the trace is unimpaired, no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited-and-missing artifact, no refund exceeds 150.00, and there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength.

Confidence: the finding rests on EV-TRIP-02837 and EV-GPS-02837, both at weight 1.0, with EV-CHAT-02837 (also 1.0) corroborating the amendment; the cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95. No money moves, so the monetary effect is zero — below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04, and the appeal route is set out in the notice.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
